row.boundary_en: Checkpoint conversion requires uptraining; the reported training cost is paper-specific. Deploying an existing GQA model differs from converting an arbitrary MHA model without training.
row.boundary_zh: 原论文转换方案需要继续训练，5% 原预训练算力是论文条件；已有 GQA 模型可直接部署，但把任意 MHA 改为 GQA 不属于免训练压缩。
row.change_en: Groups query heads around fewer KV heads, spanning the MHA-to-MQA trade-off. The paper also uptrains MHA checkpoints into the new attention structure.
row.change_zh: 让多组 Query 共享较少的 KV heads，在 MHA 的多 KV heads 与 MQA 的单 KV head 之间调节缓存规模；原论文给出从 MHA checkpoint 继续训练的方案。

row.boundary_en: This is a trained attention architecture, not generic PTQ or post-hoc SVD. DeepSeek-V2 deployment throughput also includes FP8 and KV quantization, so it is not an isolated MLA gain.
row.boundary_zh: 是配套训练的 attention 架构，不能直接等价为普通模型的 PTQ/事后 SVD。DeepSeek-V2 整体吞吐还包含 FP8、KV 量化等部署优化，不能归因于 MLA 一项。
row.change_en: Jointly compresses KV into a low-rank latent representation and decouples RoPE. Inference caches both the latent vector and an extra RoPE key; some projections are absorbed into attention weights.
row.change_zh: 对 K/V 共同做低秩潜变量表示，并解耦 RoPE；推理缓存压缩 latent 与额外 RoPE key，部分上投影可吸收入 Query/输出投影。

row.boundary_en: Changes attention parameter structure and can affect quality; it is not an arbitrary switch for a frozen MHA checkpoint.
row.boundary_zh: 改变 attention 参数结构；原论文报告存在质量代价，不能在任意冻结 MHA 模型上直接开关替换。
row.change_en: Shares one key/value head across multiple query heads, reducing architectural cache size and incremental-decoding memory traffic.
row.change_zh: 多个 Query head 共用一组 Key/Value head，从架构上减少推理缓存和增量解码的访存量。

row.boundary_en: Quality and storage depend on group size and residual length. A100 batch-capacity results do not establish Ascend gains.
row.boundary_zh: 分组大小、residual 长度会改变质量与空间；论文吞吐由单 A100、Llama-2-7B 和扩大批量得到，不能直接迁移为昇腾收益。
row.change_en: Quantizes keys per channel and values per token. Grouped cache is low-bit; incomplete residual groups stay in high precision.
row.change_zh: 按 K/V 分布分别设计量化：Key 逐通道、Value 逐 token；分组缓存用低比特，未成组的 residual 保持高精度。

row.boundary_en: The 1-bit title refers to key sketches, not all KV storage. Evaluations use 3-bit KV configurations; eliminating block scales does not eliminate norms, projections or runtime work.
row.boundary_zh: 标题的 1-bit 指 Key sketch，不是整个 KV 的位宽；实测使用 3-bit KV 配置。无需分组 scale/zero-point 不代表没有范数、投影、离群处理或计算成本。
row.change_en: Sketches keys with a random JL projection and sign bits, while projecting unquantized queries for asymmetric inner-product estimation. Values use conventional per-token quantization.
row.change_zh: Key 经 JL 随机投影再存符号位；Query 只投影，使用非对称内积估计。Value 仍按 token 常规量化。

row.boundary_en: Heads are not removed and offline preparation remains. The author implementation uses CUDA/FlashInfer; head ratio, GQA/MHA, tasks and prefill chunks affect results. Ascend compatibility is unverified.
row.boundary_zh: 不是删除整个 head，也不是完全无离线准备。作者实现依赖 CUDA/FlashInfer 等；head 比例、GQA/MHA、检索任务和预填充块大小影响结果，昇腾适配未知。
row.change_en: Keeps full-history KV for retrieval heads and short sink/recent caches for streaming heads. Synthetic-data optimization identifies the head pattern.
row.change_zh: 将 head 区分为检索头和流式头：检索头保存全历史 KV，流式头保留 sink 与近期短缓存；用合成数据优化识别 head pattern。

row.boundary_en: Historical importance cannot guarantee future-query coverage. This check covers the abstract mechanism; quality and runtime require a fixed budget, implementation and baseline.
row.boundary_zh: 历史贡献不能保证未来每个 query 的信息都被保留；来源核验限摘要机制，运行/质量细节需锁定预算、实现和基线。
row.change_en: Dynamically retains high-contribution heavy-hitter tokens and recent tokens, evicting other KV entries within a cache budget.
row.change_zh: 依据注意力贡献动态保留 heavy-hitter 与近期 token，在缓存预算内驱逐其他 KV。

row.boundary_en: Perfect single-needle retrieval does not establish lossless multi-fact reasoning. These are quality results, not Ascend speed measurements; the cited table does not specify hardware.
row.boundary_zh: 单针检索100%不等于多事实整合或长推理无损。上述数值是质量结果，未据此声称昇腾速度收益；引用表未给具体硬件。
row.change_en: A pyramidal budget schedule and pooled importance scores retain KV. This is per-layer token eviction, not cross-layer KV sharing or shared attention heads.
row.change_zh: 用金字塔形层间预算和池化后的重要性评分保留KV。它是逐层token淘汰，不是跨层KV共享，也不是头共享。

row.boundary_en: No fine-tuning does not imply lossless use for every task. Window size, cache budget and later queries matter; prefill selection is not repeated identically at every decoding step.
row.boundary_zh: 免微调不等于任意任务无损；对观察窗口、KV 预算和后续 query 分布敏感。不是在每个 decode 步重复同一次 prefill 选择。
row.change_en: Uses the final prompt observation window to select clustered important KV positions per attention head; decoding consumes the compressed prompt cache.
row.change_zh: 在 prompt 末端观察窗口估计每个 attention head 的重要历史位置，经聚合选择构建压缩缓存，decode 使用已选缓存。

row.boundary_en: Check model structure, online transforms and kernel coverage; benefits across three object tags must not be added.
row.boundary_zh: 涉及在线变换与低位矩阵计算；适配需核对模型结构及算子覆盖，不能累加三个标签的收益。
row.change_en: Uses computationally invariant rotations to reduce outliers before quantizing weights, activations and KV caches.
row.change_zh: 利用保持全精度计算等价的旋转缓解离群值，联合处理权重、激活及 KV 量化。

row.boundary_en: Requires suitable integer matrix kernels, calibration ranges and quality review; weights and activations form one coupled scheme.
row.boundary_zh: 需要目标整数矩阵核、校准范围和质量评审；权重与激活是一套耦合方案。
row.change_en: Uses equivalent channel scaling to move activation quantization difficulty into weights for joint weight-activation quantization.
row.change_zh: 通过等价通道缩放把激活离群值带来的量化难度迁到权重，支持权重与激活共同量化。

row.boundary_en: Learning incurs offline optimization; online transforms depend on configuration. QuaRot is concurrent work, not a claimed predecessor.
row.boundary_zh: 学习旋转有离线优化成本；在线变换取决于配置。与 QuaRot 为并行研究，不声称直接继承。
row.change_en: Learns rotation matrices to reduce quantization error and random-rotation variability across weights, activations and KV.
row.change_zh: 学习旋转矩阵降低量化误差，针对随机旋转结果不稳定的问题；涉及权重、激活和 KV。

row.boundary_en: Activation awareness guides weight compression; matrix shapes and quality recovery determine deployability.
row.boundary_zh: 压缩对象主要是权重，激活感知是选择依据；低秩矩阵形状和质量恢复决定部署可用性。
row.change_en: Transforms weights using activation distributions before low-rank decomposition and layer calibration; also studies KV channel reduction.
row.change_zh: 用激活分布变换权重，再进行低秩分解及层敏感度校准；论文也讨论投影分解形成的 KV 通道压缩。

row.boundary_en: The full v5 procedure includes recovery training and is not training-free; compressed matrix shapes, quality, and kernels require separate review. No Ascend measurement was made.
row.boundary_zh: 完整v5流程包含恢复训练，不能称全流程免训练；压缩后矩阵形状、质量和执行核需分别评审，未做昇腾实测。
row.change_en: Version 5 uses truncation-aware whitening followed by sequential LoRA fine-tuning of low-rank U and V factors; whitening-only SVD-LLM(W) is distinct from the full recovery procedure.
row.change_zh: v5：截断感知白化进行SVD，再顺序用LoRA微调U和V低秩因子；白化-only SVD-LLM(W) 与完整恢复流程须区分。

row.boundary_en: Distillation needs teachers, data and training budget. It is ineligible when retraining is forbidden; assess student quality separately.
row.boundary_zh: 属于训练阶段蒸馏；需要教师、数据与训练预算，禁止重训项目不适用，学生质量应单独判断。
row.change_en: Uses reverse KL and on-policy optimization to transfer white-box teacher behavior into smaller student models.
row.change_zh: 用反向 KL 与在策略优化把白盒教师能力迁到较小学生模型；实际部署对象是学生。

row.boundary_en: Zeros do not automatically reduce dense-kernel work; assess sparse storage formats and kernel support separately.
row.boundary_zh: 置零不自动减少稠密算子的工作量；稀疏存储、格式和核支持需要独立评审。
row.change_en: Uses layer-wise approximate sparse reconstruction for one-shot pruning, including unstructured and semi-structured sparsity.
row.change_zh: 使用逐层近似稀疏重建形成权重剪枝，支持非结构化及半结构化稀疏，不依赖全局重训。

row.boundary_en: Activation statistics guide pruning; runtime gains depend on sparsity patterns, kernels and task quality.
row.boundary_zh: 激活统计只用于剪枝选择；推理运行收益仍取决于稀疏模式、执行核和任务质量。
row.change_en: Prunes using weight magnitude times corresponding input activation on a per-output basis, without retraining or weight updates.
row.change_zh: 按每个输出通道内的权重幅值与对应输入激活乘积选择被剪权重，无需重训或权重更新。

row.boundary_en: TinyChat results depend on implementation and platform; they establish no Ascend compatibility or gain.
row.boundary_zh: 论文的 TinyChat 实现有平台条件；不能直接推断昇腾已适配或具有同等收益。
row.change_en: Uses activation statistics and equivalent channel scaling to protect important weight channels; this remains weight-only quantization.
row.change_zh: 通过激活统计识别重要权重通道并等价缩放，减少权重量化误差。激活用于决策，不代表激活本身被压缩。

row.boundary_en: Fix calibration data, grouping and bit width; packed low-bit weights require matching execution kernels.
row.boundary_zh: 校准分布、分组和位宽需锁定；低位权重表示需要相应打包与执行核。
row.change_en: Uses approximate second-order information to compensate layer-wise weight quantization errors after training.
row.change_zh: 以近似二阶信息补偿逐层权重量化误差，面向训练后权重压缩。

row.boundary_en: Check model structure, online transforms and kernel coverage; benefits across three object tags must not be added.
row.boundary_zh: 涉及在线变换与低位矩阵计算；适配需核对模型结构及算子覆盖，不能累加三个标签的收益。
row.change_en: Uses computationally invariant rotations to reduce outliers before quantizing weights, activations and KV caches.
row.change_zh: 利用保持全精度计算等价的旋转缓解离群值，联合处理权重、激活及 KV 量化。

row.boundary_en: Rotation prepares quantization; it is neither low-rank reduction nor pruning. Theory does not guarantee hardware gains.
row.boundary_zh: 旋转是量化预处理，不是低秩或剪枝；理论保证不等于目标硬件收益保证。
row.change_en: Combines random orthogonal incoherence processing with adaptive rounding for weight quantization.
row.change_zh: 随机正交变换改善权重与 Hessian 的不相干性，再用自适应舍入完成权重量化。

row.boundary_en: Codebook decoding needs implementation support. A project forbidding tuning must distinguish eligible steps.
row.boundary_zh: 码本解码与特定执行核需要适配；若项目禁止重训或微调，须区分可用处理步骤。
row.change_en: Explicitly improves QuIP with randomized Hadamard processing, E8 lattice vector codebooks and fidelity fine-tuning.
row.change_zh: 明确改进 QuIP：随机 Hadamard 不相干处理、E8 格点向量码本，并用微调提高重建保真度。

row.boundary_en: Learning incurs offline optimization; online transforms depend on configuration. QuaRot is concurrent work, not a claimed predecessor.
row.boundary_zh: 学习旋转有离线优化成本；在线变换取决于配置。与 QuaRot 为并行研究，不声称直接继承。
row.change_en: Learns rotation matrices to reduce quantization error and random-rotation variability across weights, activations and KV.
row.change_zh: 学习旋转矩阵降低量化误差，针对随机旋转结果不稳定的问题；涉及权重、激活和 KV。

row.boundary_en: The paper distinguishes training-free and fine-tuned results. Fine-tuned quality is not a training-free guarantee, and other vision encoders or fine-detail OCR tasks need separate review.
row.boundary_zh: 最新论文同时有免训练和微调结果，需分别读表；不能把微调精度当作免训练保证，也不能直接外推到所有视觉编码器或精细 OCR 场景。
row.change_en: Uses visual-encoder CLS attention to select important image tokens, then supplements them through key-similarity clustering/merging before the language model.
row.change_zh: 利用视觉编码器 CLS 对图像 token 的注意力选取关键 token，再以 Key 相似性聚类合并补充信息，减少进入语言模型的视觉 token。

row.boundary_en: The method is training-free, but evidence concerns the evaluated VLMs, image/video tasks and CUDA implementation. Modality and activation cells are overlapping labels, not additive gains.
row.boundary_zh: 论文方法免训练，但结果限定其 VLM、图像/视频任务及 CUDA 实现；跨模态细格与激活细格是同一机制的多标签，收益不能累加。
row.change_en: Uses relevant text tokens and self-attention to score/prune visual tokens across layers, adjusting sparsity with a rank-based strategy and recycling discarded information.
row.change_zh: 选择与视觉相关的文本 token 作为评分信号，利用自注意力逐层剪去不重要的视觉 token；按矩阵秩调节稀疏比例，并回收被删 token 的信息。
